# Onwards

> Onwards is a free mobile app (iPhone and Android) for vision boards, shared bucket lists and everyday plans. People save inspiration from any app, turn each dream into small steps with AI, and share Spaces with a partner, friends or family.

## What Onwards does
- Dreams: a digital vision board where each dream can be broken into Little Steps by Plan AI
- Saves: save places, posts and ideas from Instagram, the web or any app into one place
- Plan: shared everyday tasks and reminders, created by voice or text
- Spaces: Personal Spaces for your own plans, Shared Spaces for couples, friends and families
- Private by design: no public profiles, no targeted ads, no selling personal information

## Get the app
- [App Store (iPhone)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/onwards-together-vision-board/id6807380614)
- [Google Play (Android)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.app.onwards)
